# Skills

Every skill in `stow/pi/skills/`, linked into `~/.agents/skills/` and `~/.claude/skills/`.
"Invoked by: you" means the skill only runs when you type its name; "you or agents" means agents can also start it from its description.
Owner comes from `.skill-sources.tsv`; see [CONTEXT.md](../CONTEXT.md) for the terms.

| Skill | Invoked by | Owner | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [`agent-browser`](../stow/pi/skills/agent-browser/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Use the agent-browser CLI to navigate websites, interact with pages, extract data, and verify web app behavior in an isolated browser session. |
| [`anti-slop`](../stow/pi/skills/anti-slop/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Run the globally installed anti-slop command to check JavaScript or TypeScript, including optional Effect rules. Use after changing JavaScript or TypeScript, or when asked to check for anti-slop violations, explain its diagnostics, or fix them. |
| [`bro`](../stow/pi/skills/bro/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Restate the last message in plain human language, with no jargon. Use when the user says bro, or reacts to a dense or jargon-heavy reply with confusion. |
| [`coding-standards`](../stow/pi/skills/coding-standards/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Effect-specific engineering standards and references. Use when changing Effect services, schemas, resource scopes, or Effect-based Alchemy integrations. |
| [`decision-models`](../stow/pi/skills/decision-models/SKILL.md) | you or agents | dmmulroy | Classifier models (Jev, Clef) that answer typed questions about state with calibrated probabilities. Use when calling `models.classify` in pi codemode; when building or debugging code that calls Jev or Clef; or when replacing an LLM prompt-and-parse step, keyword match, or heuristic with typed questions. |
| [`frontend-design`](../stow/pi/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Guidance for distinctive, intentional visual design, covering aesthetic direction, typography, and choices that don't read as templated defaults. Use when building new UI or reshaping an existing one. |
| [`jev`](../stow/pi/skills/jev/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Conventions for the Jev judgment tools. Use when screening fetched or pasted content, verifying claims against evidence, ranking or classifying items by meaning, comparing passages, extracting fields, auditing extracted values, reviewing a patch, gating completion, or judging how likely a proposition is — and when choosing between Jev and rg, curl, or plain reading. |
| [`modern-web-guidance`](../stow/pi/skills/modern-web-guidance/SKILL.md) | you or agents | local | Apply Chrome's Modern Web Guidance to frontend code, then verify the built page in a real browser with agent-browser. Use when asked to build or modernize UI with web platform best practices, follow Modern Web Guidance or Baseline guidance, or check that a change fixed layout shift, respects reduced motion or the color scheme, or gives a dialog correct focus and inert behavior. Triggers include "use modern web guidance", "modern web best practices", "fix layout shift", "respect reduced motion", "add dark mode", "build an accessible dialog", and "verify this against the guide". |
